about: Higgsfield brief for the YCT 1 game questions (core/packs/yct1.js). Made with the higgsfield-art skill in his Chrome (Nano Banana Pro, Unlimited ON, 1:1, 2K). Originals -> assets-library/higgsfield/2026-10-12/yct1/<world>/<slug>.png; web copy -> public/assets/packs/yct1/<world>/<slug>.webp (Pillow thumbnail 720, WebP q82). Ordered by reference so uploads change as rarely as possible.
style: Premium glossy 3D animated movie style, cute toy-like characters and objects, rounded shapes, vibrant colors, soft studio lighting. <SUBJECT> Centered, clearly readable at a glance. Plain soft pastel <BG> background. Kid friendly. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no signs.
dralingo: Same character as the first reference image: Dralingo, the cute glossy 3D cartoon blue baby dragon with big turquoise eyes, white belly, turquoise head spikes and blue wings with white membranes. Now dressed like the second reference image: a real Emirati white kandura (a clean long white robe down to his feet, with the small tassel at the collar), a white ghutra headscarf with a black agal, and a neat black curled mustache with a short trimmed black beard like a wise Emirati sheikh. Plain wings with no letters or symbols. Pose: <POSE> Alone, no other characters.
cast: Same character as the reference image: <WHO>. Glossy 3D cartoon render like a premium animated movie. <SCENE> Alone (the only person in the picture), no airplane, no vehicle.

pictures.subject: A cozy little family house with a red door, warm lit windows and a small garden.
Three happy cartoon kids standing side by side with a small gap between each of them (not touching), all smiling and pointing at themselves together, a team.
A cute white bunny with VERY long ears that reach up high, the ears clearly much longer than its body.
A very tall friendly giraffe standing next to a tiny potted flower, so it is obvious the giraffe is tall.
A cheerful cartoon child standing straight against a colorful wall height chart with plain stripes (no numbers), measuring how tall they are.
A HUGE round watermelon next to a tiny ladybug, the watermelon is enormous.
A tiny little mouse sitting next to a giant sneaker, the mouse is very small.
A cute fluffy orange kitten sitting and smiling.
A cute bright red macaw parrot with blue and yellow wings, perched on a small branch.
A cute shiny orange goldfish swimming with a few bubbles.
A bowl of fluffy white steamed rice with a pair of chopsticks resting on the bowl.
A bowl of delicious noodles in broth with chopsticks lifting some noodles, steam rising.
A tall glass of fresh white milk with a little splash.
One shiny red apple with a green leaf.
A clear glass of cold water with ice cubes and a few water drops.
A cute small shop front with a striped awning and crates of colorful fruit, no signs and no writing anywhere.
A birthday cake with lit candles and colorful sprinkles (no numbers on it).
One shiny red apple with a green leaf, seen from the front. Pure flat green #00FF00 background instead of pastel (it will be cut out).
